name: Sleighbell Island
summary: (Example) Where the tides and the sacred flames meet.
description:
(Example text — replace it from the panel.)

Long ago, Sleighbell Island was the meeting place of the guardian of the sea and the guardian of the sky. The bells that give the island its name were cast to call them both.

Today the bells are silent, and nobody remembers who rang them last.

territories.name: Tidal Coast
territories.description: The western half of the island, carved by the sea.

safeZones.name: Harbor Town
safeZones.description: The island's only port. Ships from the rest of Bethath dock here.

dungeons.name: Whirl Caves
dungeons.description: Sea caves that flood at high tide. Something sings deep inside.

territories.name: Bell Highlands
territories.description: Hills and old temples to the east.

safeZones.name: Temple Village
safeZones.description: Monks still sweep the steps of the old bell tower.

dungeons.name: Burned Tower
dungeons.description: The ruins of a tower that burned one night and was never rebuilt.
